text:
ajay: Heads-up: planning a staggered rollout for kernel v2.14 + quant build Q3 tonight in the 00:30-02:30 UTC holdback window. Want to lock owners for the three regional canaries.
maria: I can own eu-west canary. Will run smoke and perf dashboards, ping if slippage.
hao: I'll take us-east. Quick note: the qbuild has a new matmul kernel path; please ensure model pins include fallback to v2.13.
ajay: Good call. We'll add an automatic pin TTL of 30m for any region that sees >3% p99 latency regressing.
jeff: What's rollback criteria beyond latency? Error rate spike threshold? Token correctness diffs?
ajay: Primary signals: p99 > 2x baseline OR error rate increase > 0.5% absolute OR semantic regression on the canary prompts > 10% fail rate. Any one tripped = immediate rollback and pin.
ops: Capacity note — dedicated pool usage is at 85% for us-east tonight; if canary traffic bumps, we might hit autoscale throttle. Recommend staging with 10% synthetic load first.
maria: Agree on staging probe. I'll run the staging sweep at 23:50 UTC with a small reranking workload and KV cache warmup.
hao: Deploybot, can you schedule two-step traffic shifts: 1% -> 10% -> 30% over 40m with 10m dwell? Also include rename tag "kernel-v2.14-q3".
deploybot: @ajay received. Scheduling rollout: steps=[1,10,30], dwell_mins=[10,20,10], tag=kernel-v2.14-q3. Canary regions: eu-west, us-east, ap-south. Preflight check: packaging checksum OK, staging smoke pending.
ajay: add a preflight that fails on binary checksum mismatch and quant-matrix shape warnings. If any warning logs contain "kv-cache-evict" then abort.
deploybot: Preflight hooks registered: checksum, quant-shape, kv-cache-warning. Will abort on matching warnings. Reporting channel: #eng-runtime.
jeff: Also capture a token-level diff for a small prompt set. If semantic score drop > 8% for top-k metric, roll back.
maria: I'll prepare the eval set and upload to /tmp/release_evals/kernel_v2.14_q3.json on the admin share.
hao: Quick config snippet for rollout command to paste during deploy:

```
deploybot rollout --tag kernel-v2.14-q3 \
  --regions us-east,eu-west,ap-south \
  --steps 1,10,30 \
  --dwell 10,20,10 \
  --preflight checksum,quant-shape,kv-cache-warning,semantic-diff
```

maria: I'll be on-call in the window. If I react with :thumbsup: that means smoke OK. If I post :rotating_light: that means abort and pin.
ops: If we need to roll back, what's pin TTL? ajay mentioned 30m earlier — do we extend for postmortem?
ajay: Pin TTL 30m to prevent flapping; ops can extend to 24h if postmortem is required and backfill needed. We'll document any extension with a release-note entry.
sre-bot: Reminder: submit a rollback RFC if pin extended > 6h. Use template at https://go/internal/rollback-rfc.
jeff: One more ask: include the ability to do a quick binary-only fallback (kernel v2.13 runtime but quant artifacts from v2.14) in case matmul change is culprit.
hao: That binary-only fallback path needs verification — I can test matrix compatibility tonight in staging and post results.
maria: Timelines: staging probe 23:50, preflight 00:10, canary step 1 at 00:30 UTC, step 2 at ~00:40, step 3 at ~01:00, full holdback end 02:30.
ajay: Thanks. If no objections by 22:45 UTC I'll proceed and kick the deploybot run. Tagging @maria @hao @jeff as canary owners.
ops: Noted. I'll watch autoscale metrics and stand-by for manual capacity bump if needed.
maria: :thumbsup:
hao: :thumbsup: staging tests started.
deploybot: deploybot: Preflight passed. Checksum OK. No quant-shape warnings. KV-cache logs clean. Ready to proceed.
ajay: Kicking off at 00:30 then. If anyone sees unexpected regressions, post here and ping @oncall-sre.
sre-bot: oncall-sre: night shift assignment -> @liam.

jeff: Copy. Preparing release-note stub: "kernel v2.14: matmul optimizations, quant matrix path updates. Canary rollout 00:30 UTC. Watch p99 and semantic-diff." Will post to #eng-releases after canary step 2.
maria: step1 smoke OK :thumbsup:
hao: step1 perf looks fine in us-east. Starting step2.
deploybot: Traffic shift to 10% completed for regions [us-east, eu-west, ap-south]. Monitoring dwell.
maria: step2 small p99 blip in eu-west (1.2x) but within hysteresis. Holding.
jeff: semantic diff after step2 shows 3% drop on rerank set — within acceptable.
ajay: Hold for 10m then proceed to step3 if no further blips. If eu-west p99 goes >1.5x during dwell, we abort and pin.
maria: :thumbsup:
(End of thread)
